io.milvus.bulkwriter.storage.client

Class MinioStorageClient

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.minio.S3Base
      • io.minio.MinioAsyncClient
        • io.milvus.bulkwriter.storage.client.MinioStorageClient
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    StorageClient

    public class MinioStorageClient
extends io.minio.MinioAsyncClient
implements StorageClient
    StorageClient implementation backed by a MinioAsyncClient for uploading bulk-import data files to S3-compatible cloud storage (MinIO, AWS S3, Alibaba Cloud OSS, Tencent Cloud COS, GCP, and other S3-compatible services).

    The client uploads data files as objects into a cloud-storage bucket. Large files are split into multipart parts sized to stay within the S3 part count limits, and an optional progress listener reports upload progress. This class also adjusts the multipart upload completion flow for full MinIO/S3 compatibility.

      • getStorageClient

        public static MinioStorageClient getStorageClient(S3ConnectParam connectParam)
        Creates a MinioStorageClient from a full S3ConnectParam. When the param carries an external credentials provider (e.g. AWS web identity or GCP workload identity), the provider is used so credentials refresh transparently while the writer is running; otherwise the static accessKey/secretKey/sessionToken are used as before.

        For GCP the provider's fetch() is invoked per HTTP request (the bearer token is attached by an interceptor), so providers must cache credentials internally, as the minio Provider contract requires.

        Parameters:
        connectParam - the connection parameters
        Returns:
        the configured MinioStorageClient

      • getStorageClient

                                                  String endpoint,
                                                  String accessKey,
                                                  String secretKey,
                                                  String sessionToken,
                                                  String region,
                                                  okhttp3.OkHttpClient httpClient)
        Creates a MinioStorageClient for the given cloud storage provider.
        Parameters:
        cloudName - the cloud storage name, used to detect GCP and Tencent Cloud behavior
        endpoint - the S3-compatible endpoint URL of the cloud storage service
        accessKey - the access key (not used for GCP when a session token is provided)
        secretKey - the secret key
        sessionToken - the session token, or null; for GCP this token is sent as a bearer Authorization header
        region - the storage region, or null
        httpClient - an optional OkHttpClient to reuse, or null to create and own one
        Returns:
        the configured MinioStorageClient

      • completeMultipartUploadAsync

        protected CompletableFuture<io.minio.ObjectWriteResponse> completeMultipartUploadAsync(String bucketName,
                                                                                       String region,
                                                                                       String objectName,
                                                                                       String uploadId,
                                                                                       io.minio.messages.Part[] parts,
                                                                                       com.google.common.collect.Multimap<String,String> extraHeaders,
                                                                                       com.google.common.collect.Multimap<String,String> extraQueryParams)
                                                                                throws io.minio.errors.InsufficientDataException,
                                                                                       io.minio.errors.InternalException,
                                                                                       InvalidKeyException,
                                                                                       IOException,
                                                                                       NoSuchAlgorithmException,
                                                                                       io.minio.errors.XmlParserException
        Completes a multipart upload for S3-compatible cloud storage.

        Because MinIO follows the S3 protocol, the completion flow is adjusted to handle the uploadId query parameter and to parse the returned XML into a CompleteMultipartUploadOutputModel.

        Overrides:
        completeMultipartUploadAsync in class io.minio.S3Base
        Parameters:
        bucketName - the bucket name
        region - the storage region
        objectName - the object key
        uploadId - the multipart upload identifier
        parts - the uploaded parts to assemble
        extraHeaders - extra HTTP headers to send
        extraQueryParams - extra query parameters to send
        Returns:
        a future resolving to the object write response
        Throws:
        io.minio.errors.InsufficientDataException - if request data is incomplete
        io.minio.errors.InternalException - if an internal MinIO error occurs
        InvalidKeyException - if the signing key is invalid
        IOException - if an I/O error occurs
        NoSuchAlgorithmException - if the signing algorithm is unavailable
        io.minio.errors.XmlParserException - if the response XML cannot be parsed
